scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compute every node distance from the tail of a single rooted acyclic linked list using packed pointer jumping
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Each node stores successor in high32bits and distance in low32bits of Int64. Repeatedly replace its successor by successor-of-successor and add distances until next link reaches terminal node; independent oracle traverses original list once from head0 and assigns exact distance-to-tail.
scientific_intent.discretization: Four complete single-chain fixtures: N513/1027 each ordered or source libc srand123 random permutation with head0. Source256threads and3/5blocks, one valid lane in N513 finalblock and3 valid lanes in N1027 finalblock.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Exact full packed terminal-pointer/rank state plus exact public rank values for all3080nodes. All20trialartifacts byte-identical12328Int64values; prefix6168 actualsize/randomflag/next/packedinputs exact. No floatingpoint tolerance or canonicalized outputs.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Small named multi-block chains, not original8million-nodeCLI scale. Five internal batches of4kernel launches per trial, eachreset outsideclock; five outer trials, discardonlytrial1time.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Exact Int64 packed successor/rank, signedhigh32 for NIL=-1 and UInt32 lowrankmask, nativeC++long64 onactualplatform. Fixtures rank<=1026 avoid low32overflow, pointersfit signed32. Defined hostbitpacking preserves intendedsourcebits includingNIL without executing negative signedleftshift UB.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Parallel list ranking is a domain-neutral irregular graph primitive. No applicationdata or end-to-endscientificsimulation ispresent; prefix/list-processing usecases illustrative only.
scientific_intent.description: Source-faithful in-place asynchronous packed64pointerjumping, not a silently substituted synchronous doublebuffered algorithm. Independent fullrank/state oracles pass all4models. Originalnon-atomiccrossblockloads/stores and data-dependentblockbarriers remain source-reviewed hazards; observed exactoutputs and native synccheck0 do not establish arbitrary-input/GPU race freedom.
